name: Cholera & mosquito-borne
value: DRC: 288 cholera deaths in month to 27 Oct
summary: DR Congo leads new cholera deaths globally, with 288 in the month to 27 Oct; insecurity limits access in the east
state: ECDC's monthly update of 27 Oct counts 291,272 cholera cases and 2,471 deaths worldwide in 2026, with DR Congo reporting the most new deaths since 28 Sep, 288, followed by Nigeria with 114. WHO counted over 125,000 suspected cases and 3,644 deaths in DR Congo from January 2025 to September 2026 and said insecurity in the east limits access for medical teams (Ver Angola, 15 Oct). Searches to 10 Nov found no newer WHO count; high mortality in a conflict-affected country keeps the Alert.
for_you: Risk is concentrated in conflict-affected and flood-hit areas of Africa and Asia. Travellers should check NHS fit-for-travel advice on safe water and food, and FCDO travel advice for DR Congo.
rubric_hit: Large cholera outbreak with high mortality in conflict-affected DR Congo (288 deaths in month to 27 Oct)

sources.title: Ver Angola — WHO warns of more than 125,000 suspected cases and 3,644 deaths from cholera in the DR Congo since 2025

why: Climate-sensitive diseases — cholera, dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche, West Nile and yellow fever — are hitting record levels and reaching new regions.
drivers: Conflict, floods, heat, El Niño, water and sanitation, mosquito range expansion.

rubric.alert: Large outbreaks with high mortality in conflict zones, or a WHO grade 3 emergency.
rubric.watch: Record-level seasons, or local transmission in countries where the disease was not established (including Europe).
